data.name: INMATE: Survival
data.detailed_description:
Without more space in prisons, the Government decided to test a new system. Sentencing prisoners to the "Island". The prisoners should fight against each other and survive for the sentenced time to get out of it. The government will send airdrops to the island containing weapons and provisions, making the inmates fight for it, this way the government can test new weapons and technology.

Vitals!

Managing your health, hunger and thirst will be a constant.

Fighting!

You will have to fight other prisoners to stay alive.

Hunting!

Searching for food to stay alive will force you to hunt animals like Rabbits, Crabs, Fish or even Sharks.

Explore!

Explore the island to find and raid other prisoner camps and steal their goods and weapons, or claim their base as yours.

Loot!

Every day in the game a plane will fly the island and drop a container with special loot. Also searching the ocean and the shores will find you loot.

Craft!

Crafting weapons, structures, traps, vehicles will be a constant part of your game experience.

Build!

Building a base for your protection will be super important.

Defend!

Defend your base and goods from other prisoners.

Escape!

Once your sentence is completed, a rescue point will be displayed on the map and you will be able to escape the island.

data.short_description: INMATE: Survival is an open world survival game, where you play the role of a prisoner sentenced to stay on a 4*4 km Island with many types of enemies both humans and animals.

reviews.review:
UPDATE:
This game is as good as abandoned. There have been no updates in over 8 months as of this writing, and no sign of any news by the developer.
I can only assume that the amount of issues with the game have overwhelmed the limit of the developer's talent, and the lack of positive reviews have steered many away from purchasing this game.

Whatever you do, just don't waste your money. He's probably gone back to his previous line of work selling shoes.




UPDATE 0.6 REVIEW EDIT ADDED.

If you're thinking about buying this, hold off for now. Here's why:

The days are impossibly short. I have played 2 real time hours and 4 game days have elapsed, but died 6 times and had to restart from a previous save each time. So at a guess I will say that each day is about 15  real minutes long. This gives you no time to try and explore the 16km2 of island before it gets too dark. I ventured off to retrieve an air drop 850m away and it was dark just as I returned. There's no way you can go to the other side of this island to explore without a huge risk of dying and having to revert to a previous save.
0.2 EDIT: A small improvement, but still too short. Seeing the day counter in the top left I'm going to assume that your time on the island is limited to 360 days. At the rate in which the days elapse this will be a short sentence and game.

The food ratios are imbalanced. There's a carbs/protein/water system in place which is impossible to manage. The carbs are too difficult to find. I found one corn plant in 4 in game days, and this is hardly enough to keep your carb levels in balance. If you're going to implement this system then make the required nutrition available. During this time I was taking health hits due to a zero carb level.
0.2 EDIT: I found two corn plants on a bare hill. Nowhere near enough to survive. If you're going to be dropped on an island to survive your incarceration, then food should be available otherwise it's a death sentence. The threat should come from enemy inmates, not food shortage.

There are coconuts to eat but they give you minimal carb nutrition but hit you with a 15 point sickness level, I have no idea why they make you sick. The water system is also unbalanced. I found 2 watermelons in the same timeframe which didn't go far at all. You can use coconuts for water but again, they make you sick. Pacific islanders live on this s##t.
0.2 EDIT: These still make you sick for some stupid reason, and I found no watermelons at all. This is just f#####g ridiculous, they may as well be removed from the game.

The stamina system is also flawed. You can run for 5 seconds, then have to walk for 2 seconds. Am I that unfit that I can't run for more than 5 seconds?
0.2 EDIT: Added to initial review.

You can't pause the game. If you want to take a toilet break, then exit the game otherwise the timer keeps on counting down. If you're near your base and can save and exit, then any air drops that have not been collected are lost as the locations don't save with the game.
0.2 EDIT: Still no pause. You still lose all acquired POI marks.

The enemies advance a vastly superior rate than you do. In trying to retrieve an air drop I was attacked by an armed inmate, and I was still in the stone age. As I was cracking him in the skull he was able to reload and continue firing. I was able to bring him down but the firearm he was using to beat me down to 11 health had mysteriously vanished, he was using it, why can't I?. I also approached an enemy camp and was surprised to find 2 inmates armed with pistols with a 4x4 base, and I still only had a lean-to shelter.
0.2 EDIT: I wasn't able to approach an enemy base. A POI marker came up, but I wanted to save and restart from a previous save to try and sort out the building bug and lost the location of the camp.

There's no map. How do I know where I've been or the where the locations are of any POI's that I've come across? In game I can make a multitude of incredible things like buckets, and forge metals, but I can't use some charcoal and a piece of cloth to map out my progress.
0.2 EDIT: Still no map.

The building is bugged. I had all of the required items in my inventory and placed a foundation only to find I couldn't build it. I had the hammer in hand and looked all over the foundation ghost but there was no option available to build. I had to exit at this point (I couldn't pause because that option doesn't exist) and watch a YouTube video, and the guy who posted it was able to carry out this task in the same manner in which I attempted it without issue.
0.2 EDIT: Still bugged. I decided I needed to start a new game but it didn't help. There's also no option to delete a ghost build.

The inventory system needs work. You have to physically drag and drop things to and from your inventory, there's no shift click to move items over. If the days are going to be this ridiculously short then time saving options are a must. Some of the items I can stack when I drag and drop, others just replace it.
0.2 EDIT: No change.

I just had a look at all of the reviews so far and the people who are praising this game have less than an hour in. Sounds like the dev has some friends...
0.2 EDIT: I'm glad I'm not the only one who spotted this, and as a result I would NOT put any faith into ANY positive reviews of this game. The only people who would praise this abortion are more than likely known to the dev, and the false reviews are intended for people to buy this rubbish.

So 2 hours in and I'm done with this frustration. I'll keep coming back when I see updates but at this point it's game over.
0.2 EDIT: 2.6 hours in, and a new game later I still recommend you avoid buying this game. #RAGEQUIT

0.6 EDIT: This game still sucks big time. There's many bugs and the days are still way too short. The dev doesn't seem to get the hint, so it's all over as far as I'm concerned. What a POS.
reviews.developer_response:
Hi, thank you for your construtive feedback it will help me balance the game and improve it, please know that many things you have mentioned are already in the works for the next update.

I hope you can give it another shot once the update is up and running!

Again, thanks for the feedback!
